_comment: Job openings for the careers page. Add an entry to advertise a role, then run:
python3 tools/careers.py build
That regenerates the openings section on contact/join-unicon.html and emits
JobPosting structured data for each live role, which is what makes a listing
eligible to appear in Google's job results.
Leave 'openings' empty when nothing is advertised. The page then shows a
no-current-openings state and invites speculative applications instead.
Field notes:
id           short slug, used as the anchor and the posting identifier
title        the role as a candidate would search for it
discipline   one of the disciplines listed on the page
location     town and province
type         FULL_TIME | PART_TIME | CONTRACTOR | TEMPORARY | INTERN
posted       YYYY-MM-DD, the date the role went live
closes       YYYY-MM-DD, or empty for open-ended
summary      one or two sentences, shown on the card
requirements list of strings
responsibilities list of strings
Salary is deliberately not a field. Publishing pay bands is a decision for
the business, not a default.
